source_row.rationale: Documented routine checks of emergency equipment provide a verifiable record confirming that the equipment and supplies were confirmed present, unexpired, and functional at defined intervals (such as each shift), supporting accountability, identifying and addressing any gaps promptly, and helping ensure genuine readiness for an actual emergency situation.
source_row.source_detail: Purpose of Documented Equipment Readiness Checks
source_row.source_name: AHA / Facility Policy — Emergency Equipment Check Documentation Standards
